Project Concept & Architecture

Historical sales data is stored in Amazon S3, while customer information is stored in Amazon RDS MySQL. Amazon Athena uses federated querying to combine these datasets without first moving them into a single database. AWS Lambda and API Gateway expose the analytics to the web dashboard.

Federated SQL Query

Real query executed by Amazon Athena across S3 and RDS catalogs

SELECT
    c.customer_name,
    c.city,
    COUNT(s.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount
FROM retail_analytics.sales s
JOIN rds_mysql_catalog.retaildb.customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_name,
    c.city
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

This query joins sales data stored in Amazon S3 with customer data stored in Amazon RDS using Amazon Athena Federated Query.
